CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

3. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Football.
   B. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

4. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

7. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

8. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
